This topic is part of the IB HL IBDP Environmental Science specification.

Foundations of Environmental Systems appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Foundations of Environmental Systems in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The IB HL board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Foundations of Environmental Systems.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
